root_cause_identification.reasoning: The model correctly identifies that the inclusion of token.balanceOf(_who) without verifying transferability (e.g., for blacklisted/frozen tokens like USDC) allows users to pass the check without actual usable voting power.

fix_suggestion_validity.reasoning: The suggested fix to remove token.balanceOf(_who) and rely solely on lockManager.getLockedBalance(_who) directly addresses the root cause by ensuring only transferred (and thus transferable) tokens count towards voting power.
